issues.evidence: The three real application windows occupy a narrow horizontal band beneath the logo; the subsequent isolated spreadsheet remains small within extensive dark space. Document content and assistant panels become miniature textures.
issues.suggested_action: Enlarge the central application to roughly three quarters of frame width, keep the flanking windows behind it, and finish the merge on a readable detail rather than the entire application.

issues.evidence: The chatbot and Word-like window are predominantly frontal white rectangles. Their surrounding vignette adds darkness at the edges but little directional light or spatial depth; measured luma rises from 46.4 at 00:05 to 202.9 at 00:08.
issues.suggested_action: Give these windows a consistent slight viewing angle, directional screen spill onto the surrounding office, and restrained edge reflections; preserve clean exposure around the active text.

issues.evidence: The typing insert has soft fingers and soft keyboard keys, with no clearly resolved focal anchor; measured sharpness at 00:15.6 is 3.5.
issues.suggested_action: Choose a portion of the existing insert where the active fingertips or contacted keys resolve sharply, and match its neutral skin lighting to the blue office.

issues.evidence: The tight prompt frame leaves a large empty area on the left and places the text-entry box against the bottom edge; the following frame cuts the memo into a narrow strip. This shot's measured sharpness is 57.9 and contrast is 22.7.
issues.suggested_action: Reframe from the highest-resolution recording so the complete active prompt box sits inside safe margins, then move to a balanced document-and-assistant composition with one clear focal target.

issues.evidence: The memo fills nearly the entire frame with dense body copy, a table, and small purple tracked changes; the 'It fixes.' plaque occupies another visual plane at the upper left.
issues.suggested_action: Crop to the changed paragraph and one adjacent document landmark, enlarge the diff, and place the plaque in the surrounding negative space.

issues.evidence: The tall Changes panel presents gray text on dark gray against a dark background; measured contrast for the sequence is 22.7. The red ellipse crosses the same narrow band as 'Slide 4 title' and its numeric change.
issues.suggested_action: Lift the panel's midtones locally and frame fewer rows at a larger scale; move the ellipse outside the text baselines while retaining the right-side callout.

issues.evidence: Both supplied reaction frames use almost the same frontal head-in-hands composition, blue background screen, and downward eyeline; measured sharpness is 7.6 and 7.7 respectively.
issues.suggested_action: Use the wider reaction framing once and select a distinctly tighter, sharper moment for the later insert, preserving screen direction and the existing blue rim.

issues.evidence: The supplied reveal frames show centered logo states followed by a screenshot fan and isolated window; still samples do not establish the smoothness or motion blur of this 9.37-second continuous shot.
issues.suggested_action: Verify the rendered sequence at playback speed and frame-step its fan-to-merge transition; maintain one continuous movement trajectory and remove any abrupt scale or velocity changes.

top_revision: Reframe the real product sequence around large, readable UI details with consistent directional screen light and spatial depth.
